newsitem.title: UK: B.A.T up after surge in U.S. tobacco stocks.
newsitem.headline: B.A.T up after surge in U.S. tobacco stocks.

text.p: Shares in B.A.T Industries Plc rose in premarket trading on Wednesday, echoing a surge in U.S. tobacco group Philip Morris Cos amid renewed hopes that the industry is taking steps to settle its litigation problems.
With Morris shares closing $5-7/8 higher at $131-3/8, B.A.T was up 12p at 540p by 0820 GMT.
"It almost looks like the tobacco crisis is over from the U.S. point of view," said one senior trader in London.

According to industry sources and analysts in the U.S., major tobacco companies have hired two law firms and a public relations firm to consider the possible shape of a settlement to answer the landslide of tobacco-related lawsuits.
